arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Andrew Pincus argued Florida punished lawful campaign speech.
He stated the First Amendment bars prohibiting that speech.
Richard argued Florida law allows candidates to provide donor names.
He stated this action does not violate judicial ethics canons.
